description:
Question: Is the preview understandable and is the timezone display appropriate?
Artifact: Booking-flow preview screens and explicit hourly-slot/configurable UTC assumptions.
Criteria: Owner inspects availability, own bookings, quota/conflict/cancel states and timezone labels; any requested changes are recorded.
Prerequisites: Accessible booking-flow preview. Only live integration waits on this checkpoint; backend work uses configurable timezone.
Stage-1 limitation: This is an ordinary ticket and dependency, not an enforced owner-approval gate.
title: Checkpoint: member journey and timezone display
